verdict.rationale: Milvus is open-source and can run fully local (Milvus Lite storing data in a local file) or self-hosted (Standalone on Docker, Distributed on Kubernetes). That keeps data under the user's control and implicitly away from any vendor training pipeline. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses AI-training use of customer data. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training or data-usage policy, a training opt-out control for the managed/cloud offering, and independent corroboration.
